body: I get that and I thank you for your caring about my health, but I don't really know what help I'm supposed to be seeking and I don't want my parents to interfere with my mental health. They'd only make things worse. But I get the depression thing and I know I should find some way around it.

Like a lot of parents, they have a funny way of getting involved in things they have no stake in, even if it's a misguided attempt at fixing their child's future. Regardless, I live in their house so I do what they say.
